**Attire**
Hard hat, high-visibility safety vest (neon orange or lime yellow), steel-toe boots, and work-appropriate pants (blue jeans or khaki)

**Arrival**
- Arrive 15 minutes before your assigned shift.
- Check in with the on-site foreman or project manager at the main entrance or job site office.
- Confirm your assignment and any specific access points.
- Park in the designated contractor parking area or as directed by on-site personnel.

**Duties**
- Control access to the site perimeter; verify that only authorized personnel and vehicles enter through designated entry points
- Check visitor credentials and maintain a log of who enters and exits the site
- Patrol the site perimeter regularly to identify any unauthorized access, breaches, or security concerns
- Monitor equipment and material storage areas to prevent theft or vandalism
- Ensure all gates and access points are secured at the end of the shift
- Respond to and report any incidents, accidents, or safety violations to the on-site supervisor
- Assist in enforcing safety protocols and reporting safety hazards observed during patrols
